description: This file defines an interface for building responses to 'RetrieveThing' commands within a live command processing framework. It provides methods to create success and error responses related to retrieving a 'Thing' object.

classes.name: RetrieveThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An interface that extends a query command response step for building responses to RetrieveThing commands.

classes.name: RetrieveThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: An inner interface for creating different types of responses (success and error) to a RetrieveThing command.

methods.name: retrieved
methods.description: Creates a success response containing the retrieved 'Thing' object. Throws NullPointerException if 'thing' is null.

methods.name: thingNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating the 'Thing' does not exist or is not accessible due to permission issues.
